## What's changed

- Added an opt-in Apple TV surround-audio path that converts incompatible DTS/TrueHD audio to HLS-compatible AAC 5.1 when the active HDMI route supports it.
- Apple TV now falls back to stereo only when the connected route cannot accept multichannel audio; Steam and retro players keep their existing playback behavior.
- Added output channel details to Active Streams so AAC 5.1 and stereo conversions are clearly identified in the server UI.
- Added a client-composited Tube TV channel-logo mode for Apple TV, keeping logo colors correct without altering the video while preserving the existing server-burned overlay for Steam and retro players.
